title: 第一卷 第9章 杀第一卷 第10章 毁尸灭迹
slug: 乱世加点从猎户到武圣只杀不赦
content_zh:
刘茹倒吸一口凉气，她一下猜到了李毅要做什么。
顿时瞪大着双眼，一脸不可置信。
刘茹双手死死的握着李毅，压低声音，颤抖着道：“小毅，杀人是要杀头的。”
李毅神色正常，眼中没有丝毫的动摇。
“我要是不解决掉他，最后倒霉的就会是我的家人，我没得选。”
刘茹怔怔地盯着眼前这个男人，他变了，而她的心也有了些异样。
“那你小心点一定要活着回来，为了你的弟弟妹妹，为了刘芳。也为了......我。”
李毅转过头，拿起弓箭继续练习。
“你放心，没把握的事，我是不会做的。”
刘茹点点头，默默地回家收拾衣物，她今晚就要住进来。
李毅拿起黑漆弓，架上箭矢，目光如炬，锁定远处的靶心。
咻！
箭矢发出一声呼啸，正中靶心。
百步只是开始，百步、三百步......
李毅不知疲倦地一次又一次的磨炼。
身体与弓箭的完美融合，又是两个灵魂的相互磨合。
真正做到心箭合一。
最后一次，箭矢裹胁着千斤之力射出。
崩！
木靶裂开。

李毅满头大汗，身上的酸痛达到顶点，但他能清晰地感觉的到，自己的身体正在快速恢复。
【射箭（熟练）：50500】
【效果：开三石角弓，带透甲之力！】
晚上刘茹也在李毅架吃饭，几个人凑在一起吃完饭后，李毅又出去院子继续练习。
......
第二天一早，李毅早早便离开，除了刘茹，其他人都以为他是去打猎。
进了城后，李毅径直来到了提王大贵每日必到的茶馆中，找了个不起眼的角落坐了下来。
虽然以李毅现在的【射箭】技能，完全可以做到远程射死王大贵。
但这么做，很容易被盯上。
因为在这个时代，用箭矢杀人，和在现代用枪杀人没什么区别。
李毅杀死王大贵的目的是以绝后患，而不是被官府通缉，全家陪葬。
为了达成目的，李毅出门前就准备好了药，就等着王大贵出现，找机会给他下药。
今天的李毅还特意乔装打扮一番，除非亲近之人，否则应该不会有人认识自己。
巳时，一道嚣张跋扈的声音从外头传了进来。
“小二，快给老子上壶茶，快渴死我了。”
话音刚落，王大贵就从外头大摇大摆的走了进来，身后跟着一群小弟，一个个嘻嘻哈哈的。
店小二和老板相视一眼，心中很是苦涩。
这位大爷天天来这白吃白喝，还不能得罪。
店小二只能去后厨做准备。
此时李毅已经不动声色地站起身，来到了店小二必经之路。

没过多久，就见店小二匆匆走来。
李毅看准了壶口，将预先准备好的药粉弹了进去。
小二对此一无所觉，继续拎着茶壶往前走去。
周围人也没注意到李毅的小动作，各自喝着茶。
“大爷，这是你们的茶，请慢用！”
content_en:
Liu Ru took a breath, she guessed what Li Yi was going to do.
His eyes suddenly widened with disbelief on his face.
Liu Ru held Li Yi tightly with both hands, lowered her voice and said tremblingly: "Xiao Yi, killing someone must be beheaded."
Li Yi looked normal, without any wavering in his eyes.
"If I don't get rid of him, my family will be the unlucky one in the end. I have no choice."
Liu Ru stared blankly at the man in front of her. He had changed, and there was something strange in her heart.
"Then be careful and make sure you come back alive, for your younger brothers and sisters, for Liu Fang. And for...me."
Li Yi turned his head, picked up the bow and arrow and continued practicing.
"Don't worry, I won't do anything I'm not sure about."
Liu Ru nodded and silently went home to pack her clothes. She would move in tonight.
Li Yi picked up the black lacquer bow, set up the arrows, and fixed his eyes on the bullseye in the distance.
call out!
The arrow whistled and hit the bullseye.
One hundred steps is just the beginning, one hundred steps, three hundred steps...
Li Yi worked tirelessly again and again.
The perfect fusion of the body and the bow and arrow is also the running-in of two souls.
Truly unite heart and arrow.
For the last time, the arrow was shot out with a force of thousands of pounds.
collapse!
The wooden target cracked.
Li Yi was sweating profusely, and the pain in his body reached its peak, but he could clearly feel that his body was recovering quickly.
[Archery (skilled): 50500]
[Effect: Open the three-stone horn bow, with the power of penetrating armor! 】
Liu Ru also ate at Li Yijia in the evening. After several people gathered together to finish the meal, Li Yi went out to the yard to continue practicing.
...
Early the next morning, Li Yi left early. Except for Liu Ru, everyone thought he was going hunting.
After entering the city, Li Yi went straight to the teahouse where Wang Dagui visited every day, and found an inconspicuous corner to sit down.
Although Li Yi's current [Archery] skills can completely kill Wang Dagui from a distance.
But if you do this, you can easily get caught.
Because in this era, killing people with arrows is no different from killing people with guns in modern times.
Li Yi's purpose of killing Wang Dagui was to avoid future troubles, not to be wanted by the government and to be buried with his whole family.
In order to achieve his goal, Li Yi prepared the medicine before going out, waiting for Wang Dagui to appear and looking for an opportunity to drug him.
Today, Li Yi deliberately dressed up in disguise. Unless he was close to someone, no one should know him.
At this moment, an arrogant and domineering voice came in from outside.
"Boy, please bring me a pot of tea. I'm almost dying of thirst."
As soon as he finished speaking, Wang Dagui swaggered in from outside, followed by a group of younger brothers, all of them laughing and joking.
The waiter and the boss looked at each other with bitterness in their hearts.
This old man comes here every day to eat and drink for free, and he can't offend him.
The waiter can only go to the kitchen to prepare.
At this time, Li Yi had stood up quietly and came to the only path that the waiter must pass.
Not long after, I saw the waiter walking over in a hurry.
Li Yi looked at the mouth of the pot and flicked the prepared powder into it.
The waiter was unaware of this and continued to walk forward with the teapot.
The people around didn't notice Li Yi's little movements, and they all drank tea.
"Uncle, this is your tea, please use it slowly!"
